summary: Spread the local trim daily claim budget across the UTC day

schema.detail: No schema, index or store-version changes; pacing uses the existing daily deletion counter.

rules.detail: Retention decisions and kept claims are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing trim.daily_claims values remain per-UTC-day ceilings. Available allowance advances evenly from midnight, plus a burst of ceil(daily_claims / 144) claims: 695 at the default 100,000. Missed work can catch up to that line, never beyond the daily ceiling. Existing short writer transactions and pauses remain in effect. Large envelopes drain their claims over multiple allowances before the envelope is removed. Backup restoration remains unpaced.

downtime.detail: No migration; pacing takes effect on process restart.

manual.detail: No new configuration. A daily_claims value of 1 still permits one deletion per UTC day.

recovery.detail: Existing daily counters and trim cursors remain readable by earlier binaries. Restarting does not reset the daily count.
